summary: The refresh success path now confirms before force-reloading the model whitelist, and a focused source-level test verifies the guard ordering.

evidence: static/admin.js checks modelsHasUnsavedChanges() and asks for confirmation immediately before loadModelsWhitelist({ force: true }), so edits made while the POST is pending are not silently replaced.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts adds a focused assertion that the confirmation guard precedes the force reload.
